paras.text: 18. State four big heads of the expenses of the government.

paras.text: A. They are as follows: (i) the government spends on construction work, e.g. roads etc.; (ii) the government spends to improve the system of education; (iii) the government spends on maintaining health, e.g. hospitals etc.; (iv) the government spends to improve the system of defence.

paras.text: 19. What is meant by private finance?

5. Excise duty is a tax of this kind:

(a) direct tax  (b) indirect tax ✓

(c) proportional tax  (d) non-proportional tax

6. The nature of income tax is:

(a) indirect  (b) direct ✓

(c) regressive  (d) equal rate

7. The best system of taxes is this:

(a) direct tax  (b) indirect tax

(c) which fulfils the principles of imposing tax ✓

8. The objective of fiscal policy:

(a) imposing more tax  (b) imposing less tax

(c) maintaining full employment (Full Employment) in the country ✓

9. Taxes imposed on goods are called:

(a) indirect tax ✓  (b) direct tax

(c) progressive tax  (d) proportional tax

10. Which is not a source of income of the central government:

(a) water rate (abiana) ✓  (b) income tax

(c) tariff  (d) wealth tax

11. All those measures which the government takes for receipts and expenses are called:

(a) agricultural policy  (b) fiscal policy ✓

(c) tax policy  (d) none of these

12. Under which principle does every person pay tax according to his capacity?

(a) principle of elasticity  (b) principle of equality ✓

(c) principle of convenience  (d) principle of diversity

13. Wealth tax is:

(a) regressive tax  (b) value-added tax

(c) proportional tax  (d) direct tax ✓

14. The burden of which tax is not transferred to poor people?

(a) excise tax  (b) sales tax

(c) income tax ✓  (d) customs duty

15. The central government collects this share of its income from taxes:

(a) 24.63%  (b) 75.32% ✓

(c) 50%  (d) 68%

16. The share of indirect taxes of the Government of Pakistan is:

(a) 68% ✓  (b) 50%

(c) 16%  (d) 18%
